summary.text: Jonathan Garrard is the Constitution Party candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 29, an open seat with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and former city council member, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running for principled, constitutional government.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Garrard earned a high school diploma from Tooele High School and attended Utah State University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father of ten, small-business owner and former city council member.
Garrard ran as the Constitution Party candidate for Utah's 2nd Congressional District in 2012, when Republican Chris Stewart won the general election.
In the 2026 survey, he said he has served as a convention delegate and in local government.
He said his campaign centers on principled, constitutional government and on representation and accountability.
